**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

The agreement grants TrueLink no audit, inspection or usage-verification right against Mortgage Logic. Targeted searches for *audit, inspect, records, books, verif, monitor, premises, right to review* returned nothing, and both planner-flagged homes are clean:

- **§5/§6 (Compensation, p0045–p0047):** the only records mechanic runs in our favour — TrueLink must provide documentation supporting charges on request, and we may contest charges (subject to timely payment of contested amounts).
- **§8 (Client Covenants, p0050–p0058):** substantive covenants only (compliance with laws, access restriction, content warranties), with no inspection or reporting-verification right.

The two access-flavoured provisions are not audits: §8(f) (p0058) is TrueLink's right to implement technical anti-spam mechanisms, and p0060 is *our* grant of access so TrueLink can perform Y2K remediation at its own cost.

Because no audit right is asserted against us, there is no frequency, notice, cost-allocation or system-access term to constrain, and nothing approaching the walk-away position (unlimited/unannounced audits or remote access to our systems). Inserting the preferred limits would create an audit right that does not currently exist — a net loss for us — so no redline was proposed.
